svg.title: Diagnostic names and source move out of StoreDiags
svg.desc: The listener identifies tidy diagnostics; StoreDiags no longer receives a ClangTidyContext and preserves supplied metadata. Compiler diagnostics retain their Clang source and -W name. Flushing, compiler metadata fallback, generic finalizer dispatch and deduplication stay in StoreDiags.
svg.text: Diagnostic names and source move out of StoreDiags
The listener identifies tidy diagnostics; StoreDiags no longer receives a ClangTidyContext and preserves supplied metadata.
// The ClangTidyContext populates Source and Name for clang-tidy diagnostics.
// Compiler warnings keep their clang source and -W name, even when their
// severity or suppression is controlled by clang-tidy options.
// Do not forget to emit a pending diagnostic if there is one.
// Fill in name/source now that we have all the context needed to map them.
// Feature modules may already have supplied diagnostic metadata.
// Warnings controlled by -Wfoo are better recognized by that name.
Compiler diagnostics retain their Clang source and -W name.
Flushing, compiler metadata fallback, generic finalizer dispatch and deduplication stay in StoreDiags.
Colors follow git diff · unchanged context is gray · arrows map responsibilities, not entire excerpts
